issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) defines public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This discrepancy can cause students to implement the wrong return type (String) based on the UML and then fail compilation or automated tests that expect an int, or conversely to be confused about which artifact is authoritative.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Recommended: update the problem statement UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int to match the solution and expected tests. Alternatively, if the intended return type is String, change the implementation and any tests to return a String and update the reference solution. Also ensure the template TODO and any example usages reflect the chosen return type so students are not misled.
